notes.title: No Longer Supported
notes.content:
Due to financial issues I am no longer able to support this game. I apologize to all the people who wanted more from this game. I too wanted to be able to work on it further and add more features to it. But real life is a bitch at times and does not always go your way. I'm sadden by this as this was a passion of mine but I have to accept what has happened and move on.
Every indie developer out there knows that this is a really hard job but we do it cause we love making games for people. But we also know it is very hard to make it in this industry. So we have to know when to walk away, and it is my time now to walk away.
Good-bye.

PS: I tried to set the price to $0 but Steam will not allow that. So the price has been set to the lowest I can make it. So it should be $0.99 USD soon.

notes.title: New Update v1.1.4: Keyboard Configuration
notes.content:
Yes Glyphs does indeed have keyboard configs and now you can set them to what you want as well as if you want to see the Tool Tips or not. Find the Settings Panel on the Main Screen or in the Game Screen when you click the blue Menu Button to leave the Game Screen.

As always if you have questions or problems then please post them here in the Community Hub and I'll get to them as soon as possible.

Thanks for all your comments on and your interest in Glyphs. It means a lot to me to see this community growing. :-)

Scott Kingdon
Glyphs Dev

notes.title: New Update v1.1.3: Tool Tips!
notes.content:
As promised Glyphs now has tool tips for all the buttons in the game area. Also when you are testing your solution click on any tool and it will tell you what that tool is doing.

I hope you are enjoying the game and if you have any questions or comments I will get to them as soon as I can. Hope to hear from you.

notes.title: What's Next For Glyphs: Apprentice
notes.content:
A reviewer named Kevin Fenix over at Fan Boy Nation reviewed Glyphs and said that he would like to see tool tips in the game. In looking over the various other reviews which Glyphs has gotten I see that Glyphs could use some tool tips. So I am working now on creating these to allow people to get into the game faster and explore the game on their own easier. At some point when players have become more comfortable with Glyphs then they will be able to turn off the tool tips if they want to.

I also will be expanding the Debugging Panel to allow the player to see what any tool is doing at any time while testing their solution.

Anyway I hope you are all enjoying Glyphs and if you have any comments or questions then please feel free to make them on the Community Hub and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

notes.title: New Update For Glyphs: Apprentice
notes.content: Glyphs now has a new debugging feature which allows you to see in game what your solution is doing at every single step. This will give you more control over your solution and allow you to solve puzzles easier without having to try to figure out where your solution went wrong.
